:::{#def-joint-entropy}
#### Joint entropy

Let $X$ and $Y$ be discrete random variables with joint
probability mass function $p(x, y) \eqdef \P(X=x, Y=y)$.
Their **joint entropy** is the entropy of the pair $(X, Y)$:

$$H(X, Y) \eqdef -\sum_{x, y} p(x, y) \log p(x, y),$$

where the sum runs over the pairs with $p(x, y) > 0$.

:::
